column1: # CyFj11 FlowJo Export Validation — Population Counts
#   Open each flowjo_export_tests/testNN/testNN_export.wsp in FlowJo 10 and FlowJo 11.
#   Record the event count shown next to each population in the hierarchy panel.
#   The "gate_name" column is the population name as it appears in FlowJo.
#   The "channels" column shows which axes the gate lives on — use this to find
#   the correct plot in FlowJo if needed.
#   Leave fj10_count / fj11_count blank if a population is absent or WSP fails to open.
#   diff columns are computed by the analysis script — leave blank.
#   For tests 09–13: also export the full statistics table from FlowJo
#   (File > Export > Statistics) and save as testNN_fj10_stats.csv / testNN_fj11_stats.csv
#   bool:AND = boolean AND of named populations
# NOTE: log-transform roundtrip drift expected — small count difference is documented
